Baptism is also a sign of our blessed hope. Baptism is so important. It means so much.
Scripture teaches us that. And Christ Himself enjoins it. And the church practices it.
We need to consider that. And more.
gracious Father, gracious Father, having filled our minds with pictures of what it has taken

We bow before you.
We worship you.
What an amazing love that you would care so much about us.
Your creatures, thoughtlessly carrying on in sin and rebellion against you as we once were.
That you would care so much, love us so much that you would send to us your very own son.
To suffer, to die in our stead. Our hearts are filled with thanks for your mercy on us.
And we offer up our thanks this morning in the unmatched name of your son, Jesus.
